scope: One shared set geometry; no per-card renderer offsets. Full raw audit retained, with separately guarded frame-normalized metrics. No typography or whole-card fidelity certification.
visualFindings: The raw width increase was not adopted: after independent frame normalization, the original width matches the stable native pairs more closely.

Higher-quality mask downsampling smooths stepped blade edges. Structural medians and lower-tail scores are nearly unchanged or slightly lower; do not claim an accuracy gain from this sampling-only change. No raw or registered edge regression exceeds .02.

The retained hilt hook/guard, dangling cord and blade contour differ from the print. Flat gray backing does not reproduce the printed blade shading. Thin light edge details need inspection before adding any exterior rim.
Aligned calibration crops and the six lowest aligned results were inspected. The latter are Hurr Jackal, Aladdin, Bird Maiden, Ali from Cairo, Mijae Djinn and Kird Ape.
Registration covers W/U/R/A only. Black and green have insufficient reliable stock anchors, and lands use other source assets. Preserve those failures; no transfer is certified.
